high_level_description: This image captures a scene of an ornate building with Gothic architectural elements, likely undergoing restoration or maintenance as indicated by the scaffolding on its facade. The building features pointed arches, intricate stonework, and a prominent tower with a conical roof. The structure is bathed in warm sunlight, suggesting it was taken during the late afternoon or early evening. In the foreground, there is a tree with dense foliage partially obscuring the view of the building. The tree's branches extend across the frame, adding a natural element to the urban setting.
